notes: The tuition fee is quoted in USD (7,000 USD/Year on the programme page, and 7,500 USD/year on the university tuition fee page for Bachelor programs with 8 semesters). The application deadline is stated only as 15th June (no year) and no non-EU-specific wording, so it is recorded as a recurring deadline. The university also mentions an application deadline of 15 June 2026 for all other programs, but this is a specific academic year and not labelled for non-EU applicants. The exact tuition fee quoted on the main tuition page for Vehicle Engineering appears in the row 'Vehicle Engineering * Electrical Engineering * Civil Engineering * 8 semesters 7,500 USD /year'.

evidence.quote: Applicants must have an English proficiency of at least B2 level as the program is fully taught in English.
Please note, that you are not strictly required to have a language exam certificate, your language skills will be assessed during the entrance interview.
a TOEFL test with a minimum score of 513 (Paper-Based). an IELTS test with a minimum score of 5.5.

note.fr: Les résultats de l'examen d'entrée doivent être de 75% et plus pour être admis; les candidats ayant 60%-75% sont admis au programme préparatoire. Vérifiez cette condition.
note.en: Entrance exam results of 75% and over mean admission to the selected programme, results between 60%-75% mean admission to a preparatory (foundation year) programme. Check this condition.

evidence.quote: Results about 75% and over mean admission to the selected programme, results between 60%-75% -admission to a preparatory (foundation year) programme.
